}}'''Shyanda''' is an [[Wise One]] of the [[Goshien]][[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc|Shyanda}}}} She can channel.

==Apperance==
She has fiery red hair.

==Activites==
She takes part in the first-sister bonding ceremony with [[Aviendha]] and [[Elayne Trakand]].

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
